name: Michiko Verxina
original_name: ミチコ・ヴァルシーナ
source:
Occupation: Producer
Hobbies: Killing time
Skills: Sex
Likes: People who are overflowing with adrenaline
Dislikes: Boredom

The producer of "Closed GAME". She was born and raised in Caelum Urbs, but was raised as a human. In the Heaven, things such as having sex and exchanging body fluids are considered vulgar, and humans who possess extreme sexual drives are considered as criminals. In order to gain the trust and support of the Heaven's people, she produced all kinds of freak shows for them, with Closed GAME being one of them. Thanks to them, Michiko has gained tremendous popularity in the Heaven and trust of the Heaven's people, with her shows having excellent viewer rates and being extremely successful there.
